office: the Afghanistan Central Civil Registration Authority (ACCRA)

routes.label: in person at an ACCRA office

note: Landinfo's report on Afghan identity documents (22 May 2019), from the Norwegian ID Centre: an e-tazkira costs 100 afghani, requires personal attendance (biometric data from 18) and has an unlimited period of validity; a paper tazkera costs 10 (not modelled). The authorities in power since 2021 aren't distinguished; the time isn't stated.

sources.title: Landinfo, Afghanistan: Tazkera, passports and other ID documents (22 May 2019), on ecoi.net
sources.said: applicants over the age of 18 must give biometric data ... It costs 100 Afghani, equivalent to about 11 NOK ... has an unlimited period of validity.
